work.objective: Independently implement a reconciler-safe, 80x24 height-aware /help dialog and close it through the renderer raw-input stage on plain Escape, leaving Ctrl+C to the application and real PTY proof to the verifier.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths for all operations.
Only modify the four allowlisted help files; no Ink, dependency, lockfile, Marshal-state, commit, push, publication, network or subagent changes.
Implement independently from the frozen base and stated requirements; do not inspect or copy previous help run artifacts/worktrees.
Use only supported string/span children in TextNodeRenderable and keep footer/hints visible at 80x24.
Use renderer addInputHandler/removeInputHandler while the overlay is active to consume only plain raw Escape and invoke onClose once; do not consume Ctrl+C or unrelated sequences.
Worker checks may use OpenTUI vitest, CLI typecheck/build and git diff --check only; native Bun/PTY belongs to verifier.
If denied, do not retry the denied path; use an allowed equivalent or report blocked.
context: The dialog must avoid nested TextRenderable children and bound variable shortcut/command rows so footer remains visible at 80x24.
Parsed useKeyboard plus focused onKeyDown did not receive the real PTY Escape lifecycle; raw renderer input is the required route.
Verifier requires ready → /help → visible For … more help footer → raw Esc → Ctrl+C → EOF.
